Title: Generally available: Microsoft Purview Data Estate Insights

Body.Content:
Get a bird’s eye view of your data estate’s health and your governance program’s adoption. Microsoft Purview Data Estate Insights empowers the office of the Chief Data Officer by giving an overall summary of the data estate. Whether you are a Chief Data Officer, a data steward or a data owner, learn about your data estate, and spot and close gaps in a few clicks with stewardship, asset, classification, label, glossary insights and more. 

Learn more.
